title: The Sacred Geometry of Vishnupad Footprint — Sacred Measurement & Cosmic Alignment
metaDescription: Explore the sacred geometry, 40cm basalt footprint alignment, and cosmic energy fields of the Lord Vishnu Footprint at Vishnupad Temple Gaya.
author: Acharya Pandit V. K. Gayawal
reviewedBy: Vishnupad Temple Trust & Gayawal Purohit Sabha
summary: The divine footprint of Lord Vishnu at Vishnupad Temple is stamped 40cm deep into solid basalt. This article explores the sacred geometric ratios, octagonal mandap alignments, and cosmic energy resonances recorded in ancient texts.
content:
The Vishnupad Temple (Vishnu Pada Mandir) houses the sacred 40cm footprint of Lord Vishnu stamped into solid basalt rock. Ancient Vedic texts such as the Vayu Purana and Vishnu Samhita document the precise mathematical and geometric alignments of this divine footprint.

### Geometric Ratios & Octagonal Alignment
The temple structure rebuilt by Queen Ahilya Bai Holkar in 1787 features an octagonal shikhara rising 30 metres. The central footprint basin is oriented along the cardinal north-south axis:
- **Footprint Length**: Exactly 40 cm (16 inches / 1 Hastaka)
- **Basalt Basin Depth**: 15 cm depression encircled by silver plating
- **108 Shrines**: The surrounding octagonal gallery contains 108 minor shrines representing the cosmic cycle

### Cosmic Energy Fields & Pinda Placement
During Pind Daan, the hereditary Gayawal Purohit places sesame and rice Pindas directly inside the silver-rimmed footprint basin. The physical contact between the sacred grain and the basalt stone transmits the energetic Sankalpa directly to the departed ancestors.

sections.heading: Why the Footprint Geometry Grants Salvation
sections.body: According to the Gayasura Mahatmya in the Vayu Purana, when Lord Vishnu pressed His foot upon Gayasura's chest, the stone absorbed the divine energy of cosmic preservation. The exact contours of the 9 sacred symbols (Shankha, Chakra, Gada, Padma, Dhwaja, Vajra, Ankusha, Yava, Rekha) embedded on the footprint stone generate a unique vibrational resonance during Vedic mantra recitation.

sections.heading: Pilgrim Guidelines for Footprint Darshan
sections.body: Devotees can observe the silver-encased footprint during open darshan hours (5:00 AM – 12:00 PM and 4:00 PM – 9:00 PM). Pitraya Rituals arranges dedicated priest assistance for seamless Pind Daan offerings at the footprint stone.

faqs.question: What is the exact size of the Vishnupad footprint?
faqs.answer: The footprint measured inside the basalt basin is 40 centimetres (16 inches) long, containing 9 sacred symbols of Lord Vishnu.

faqs.question: Why is Pind Daan performed at the footprint stone?
faqs.answer: Offering Pindas at Lord Vishnu's footprint is believed to deliver ancestors directly to Vaikuntha, fulfilling the divine boon granted to Gayasura.
